sections.heading: Scope of Cover
sections.body: Section I covers loss of or damage to the insured vehicle including the refrigeration unit and insulated body declared in the schedule, caused by fire, explosion, self-ignition, lightning, burglary, riot and strike, malicious act, terrorism, flood, cyclone, landslide and accidental external means, subject to the Insured Declared Value stated above. Section II covers legal liability to third parties for death, bodily injury and property damage as per the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, together with compulsory personal accident cover for the owner-driver.

sections.heading: Limitations as to Use
sections.body: The policy covers use of the vehicle only for the carriage of goods within the meaning of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, under a valid permit. It does not cover use for organised racing, pace making, reliability trials, speed testing, or use for any purpose not permitted by the vehicle permit. Carriage of hazardous goods is excluded unless specifically endorsed.

sections.heading: Driver Clause
sections.body: Any person driving the vehicle must hold an effective driving licence valid for transport vehicles at the time of the accident and must not be disqualified from holding or obtaining such a licence. Driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs is excluded.

sections.heading: Special Conditions and Exclusions
sections.body: Breakdown of the refrigeration plant due to mechanical or electrical failure, wear and tear, and spoilage or deterioration of perishable cargo arising from temperature variation are not covered under this policy. Consequential loss, depreciation and loss of use are excluded. Cargo carried is not insured under this policy and must be covered separately under a marine transit policy.

sections.heading: Important Notice
sections.body: In the event of an accident, notify the insurer immediately on toll-free number 1800-345-7718 and do not move the vehicle without permission except as required by law. Grievances may be addressed to the Grievance Redressal Officer at the head office or to the Insurance Ombudsman, Kolkata. Stamp duty of Rs. 1/- (Rupees One Only) has been paid by consolidated payment. This schedule read with the policy wordings forms the contract of insurance. Receipt No. GVG/RCPT/25/7746021.
